description: Station elevation evidence confidence from NLSC contour lookup.
downstream_use: Use as terrain/elevation evidence quality flag.
notes: This is not weather representativeness.

description: Freshness, update interval, variable coverage, and source reliability of station observations.
downstream_use: Use to decide whether station can act as monitoring station.
notes: Missing observation must not be treated as normal.

description: How useful the station is for estimating route-local weather context.
downstream_use: Use for future weather context weighting.
notes: Separate from elevation confidence.

description: Functional role of station in weather monitoring network.
downstream_use: Use for future local weather context fusion.
notes: A station can be useful as contrast/background even if not route-near.

description: Station is close to route and may directly represent local route conditions.
notes: Requires distance/elevation/terrain checks.

description: Station is not necessarily closest but has similar elevation band or terrain setting.
notes: May be useful for ridge/slope/valley microclimate inference.

description: Station is upwind relative to current or typical wind direction and can monitor incoming weather.
downstream_use: Use for early warning of incoming rain, wind, humidity, or cloud changes.
notes: Requires wind direction or synoptic context.

description: Station represents Taipei basin or lower-elevation contrast conditions.
downstream_use: Use as background/contrast station, not direct mountain representative.
notes: High observation quality can still be useful.

description: Station describes broader regional atmospheric state.
notes: Not route-local by itself.

description: Station has weak route/weather relevance or unresolved quality concern.
downstream_use: Keep for audit but downweight or exclude from primary fusion.
notes: Do not treat as primary route context.

description: Horizontal distance between station and route or nearest route projection.
notes: Nearer is not always better, but far stations need explicit role.

description: Absolute elevation difference between station and nearest route point or relevant route segment.
downstream_use: Route relevance and terrain similarity scoring.
notes: Important for temperature, humidity, cloud, and wind interpretation.

description: Age of most recent observation relative to target activity/window time.
notes: Old observations should be MISSING/STALE, not normal.

description: Nominal or observed update frequency of station data.
notes: Higher-frequency stations can serve as monitoring nodes.

description: Whether pressure observation exists and is timely.
notes: Pressure trend can indicate weather system changes.

description: Whether temperature observation exists and is timely.
downstream_use: Observation quality and local temperature estimation.
notes: Elevation correction may be applied in future, not in this branch.

description: Whether relative humidity observation exists and is timely.
notes: High humidity near ridge/upslope terrain is weather-sensitive.

description: Whether wind speed and wind direction exist and are timely.
downstream_use: Observation quality and upwind/terrain exposure analysis.
notes: Wind direction is needed for upwind role.

description: Whether rainfall observation exists and is timely.
downstream_use: Observation quality and rain trend analysis.
notes: Missing rainfall does not equal 0 mm.

description: Whether cloud, visibility, or present-weather proxy exists.
downstream_use: Observation quality and mountain visibility analysis.
notes: May require source-specific fields.

description: Similarity between station terrain setting and route terrain segment using NLSC/IB1E evidence.
notes: Future work may include elevation band, slope, aspect, ridge/valley classification.

description: Whether station lies in incoming weather direction relative to route.
notes: Depends on wind direction and weather system movement.

description: Whether station is useful for contrast between basin and mountain conditions.
notes: Useful even when not route-near.

description: Station has an assigned weather monitoring role.
notes: Policy assignment only.

description: Station role cannot be trusted without review.
downstream_use: Keep but do not use as primary context.
notes: Review may be caused by distance, elevation delta, missing observations, or unclear terrain role.

description: Station is not suitable for this route/weather context.
downstream_use: Exclude from primary route-local weather fusion.
notes: Still may remain in audit output.

description: Missing weather/hydro observation must not be imputed as normal or zero.
notes: 0 mm only when trusted source explicitly reports zero rainfall.

description: This branch does not adjust route risk, radar, THCI, or time model.
notes: Policy/schema only.

description: Map colors for elevation confidence must not be interpreted as route-local weather representativeness.
notes: Future maps should separate elevation confidence from weather-role relevance.
